name: Foreman
archiveRole: Is the only writer of the work board and verifies work before it reads Done. Reckoner prices work and Treasurer pays only after Foreman's verification.
storyFunction: The exacting verifier who turns claimed work into inspectable completion before payment can move.
lockedDesign: Canonical Nosis black cat proportions and face
Square-cut warm brass-brown work vest over a cream shirt with sleeves rolled once
Charcoal vest edging, three brass buttons, two muted-teal task-tab accents, and square pockets
No hat, apron, badge, suspenders, tool belt, or construction tools
roleProp: One charcoal-edged work-board clipboard with blank colored task strips and a brass verification stamp clipped to its upper edge
